John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010, according to the Society's profile page (ForMemRS, Elected 2010) and a University of Texas at Austin report of the election. Neither 2019 nor 1992, the two options in the team note, matches that record. My confidence is high, but I checked only the search snippets, not the profile page itself.

CONFIDENCE: 88
